remarks: Introducing an exceptional opportunity to own a spacious penthouse in the highly desirable Classic Condominium, located in the heart of downtown Stamford. This stunning 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom single-level residence features large bedrooms, expansive balconies, and views of Long Island Sound.  Enjoy the ultimate urban lifestyle with restaurants, cafes, shopping, recreation, and entertainment nearby. Conveniently located minutes from I95, the Metro North and Amtrak station.  Amenities include 24/7 concierge desk, a club room, gym, indoor heated pool, rooftop lounge, outdoor grills, and a dog park. Revel in the panoramic city views, breathtaking sunsets, and vibrant nightscapes. Live the life you've always dreamed of!
